summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of the Static Page Edit Flow in The Monolith CMS. All critical edit flow features working end-to-end: login, canvas rendering, element selection, live content editing, draft/save/publish cycle, public API delivery, undo/redo, device modes, history panel, and page switching between Homepage and About.

issues: When PagesList panel is active, clicking the HISTORY tab underlines HISTORY in TopBar but the main area still shows the Pages list (showHistory conditional requires !showPagesList). Minor UX: HISTORY tab should either auto-close PagesList or be disabled while PagesList is shown.

Ctrl+S keyboard shortcut is intentionally ignored when focus is inside an INPUT/TEXTAREA (EditorPage.js lines 88-90). Users typing in the PropertyPanel must blur first or click the Save button. Consider allowing Ctrl+S in inputs since that is the normal save UX.

passed_tests: Login with admin@monolith.cms / admin123
Editor loads Homepage by default with 16 canvas elements rendered
TopBar shows page name + PUBLISHED status badge
Clicking canvas-element-hero-headline selects it, shows green outline + 'Headline (H1)' label
PropertyPanel shows Element Selector header, Content section with textarea containing current text
Typing in property-input-text updates canvas LIVE (no save needed)
Status badge flips to DRAFT after edit and yellow dirty indicator appears
Save button appears in TopBar when dirty, disappears after successful save
Save persists to backend (verified via re-fetch)
Publish button changes status to PUBLISHED
Public API GET /api/public/default/content returns the newly saved text
Undo (Ctrl+Z) reverts text change on canvas
Redo (Ctrl+Y) re-applies the change
Device mode mobile -> canvas-frame maxWidth=375px
Device mode tablet -> canvas-frame maxWidth=768px
Badge element shows Content text field
Button element (hero-cta-primary) shows Content text + Link href fields
Image element (grid-image-large) shows Image URL (src) + Alt Text fields
Card element (feature-card-1) shows Title + Text fields
Heading element shows Text Highlight section (word + color) for elements with highlight content
HISTORY tab switches panel and version list is rendered
LeftSidebar Pages icon toggles PagesList in canvas area
PagesList shows Homepage (PUBLISHED, 16 elements) and About (DRAFT, 9 elements)
Clicking About in PagesList navigates to About page with canvas-element-about-headline rendered
About headline text loads correctly: 'We believe in the power of clarity.'
action_items: (Minor UX) Allow Ctrl+S save shortcut to work even when focus is in PropertyPanel inputs - currently it is filtered out. The test request explicitly asks 'Ctrl+S triggers save' which only works after blur.

(Minor UX) When user is on HISTORY tab and clicks the Pages sidebar, the HISTORY underline stays lit but PagesList takes over the canvas area. Consider resetting activeTab to 'structure' when opening PagesList, or auto-closing PagesList when tab is switched.
critical_code_review_comments: EditorPage.js line 85-111: keydown listener is registered WITHOUT dependency array (re-registers on every render). Works but adds cost; intentional per comment. Acceptable.
EditorPage.js handleSave/handlePublish swallow errors silently via console.error with no user-facing toast. Failure would confuse users. Recommend adding a toast notification.
Canvas.js hardcoded sectionStyles map (lines 49-75) is a known limitation per the review note; non-default sections fall back to generic padding. Acceptable for this test.
PropertyPanel.js: hasHighlightField requires localContent.highlight to exist - means headings without a highlight field never get the section, which is correct behavior.

EditorPage.js handleContentUpdate pushes BEFORE state on EVERY keystroke (line 139). This creates many undo steps (one per character). Consider debouncing or grouping into word-level undo entries for better UX.
seed_data_creation: Test left hero-headline with TESTAGENT_EDIT_<timestamp> published to default project. Main agent may wish to reset demo content if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static page edit flow is fully working. Core flow: login -> canvas loads -> click element -> edit in PropertyPanel -> live update -> save/publish -> public API returns new text. All element types (heading, paragraph, badge, button, image, card, quote) wire correctly to PropertyPanel sections. Undo/redo, device modes, HISTORY tab, and page switching work. Only minor UX polish items remaining (Ctrl+S in input, HISTORY+PagesList interaction). Next agent should test the IntegrationDocs/Schema-Import flow as that was out-of-scope here.
rca: No bugs required RCA. My first test script failed because I used text=Homepage selector which also matched the TopBar 'HOMEPAGE' label. Second script used data-testid selectors exclusively and all 25 tests passed. Confirmed via canvas element list: 16 elements rendered on Homepage, 9 on About.
